Too easy. Please use another idea for your contribution.

Also, please study the formatting syntax described on this page: https://www.codingame.com/playgrounds/40701/help-center/statement , and format your statement properly following the example there in your future contributions.

Thanks.

Hi! Thanks again for the feedback on my previous version.
I’ve reworked the puzzle with a new idea and applied the formatting guidelines from the documentation you've given.
Please let me know if this version aligns better with the contribution standards.

The idea could work, but in its current form, it's too simple to be a puzzle. You could consider re-creating the contribution as a clash of code.

As mentioned earlier, please remember to format the statement correctly.

Also, the Goal section contains too much story/flavour text that isn't relevant to the task. Please try to shorten it as much as possible and keep the focus on the actual objective.
